description: Records the customer's 1–5 star rating and optional comment for a delivered Fold order (rating again replaces the earlier one). Works with the connected account, or order code + the email used when scheduling. For a high rating the response includes Fold's public review link the customer may choose to use; for a low rating it notes that report_issue opens a support case (re-clean, damage, missing item).

comment.description: Optional, up to 500 characters, in the customer's words.

email.description: Not needed with a connected account.

name: rate_order
title: Rate an order
